{{Quote|To attain the Mark of Altruism, you must selflessly help a soul in need. Somewhere, in the harsh desert heat, a farmer desperately cried out...in need of a hero.|A [[Unidentified Rodian hermit|Rodian hermit]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMotH">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|The Mark of the Hero|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
The '''Mark of Altruism''' was a sculpture. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was awarded to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] after they completed a [[Quest of the Hero of Tatooine|task]] in an effort to become a [[Hero of Tatooine|hero]], which displayed their altruism and selflessness. When combined with the other "Mark" sculptures, the [[Mark of Intellect]], the [[Mark of Honor]] and the [[Mark of Courage]], it formed a spherical shape.<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />

==History==
{{Quote|In order to deserve the Mark of the Hero, you must undergo four different tasks and gain the Marks of Courage, Honor, Intellect, and Altrusim.|A Rodian hermit, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a spacer, under the task of a strange [[Unidentified Rodian hermit|Rodian hermit]], gained this sculpture after displaying true altruism by assisting a poor [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] in rescuing his wife and child from a vicious criminal gang known as the [[Sennex]] in a [[Beetle Cave|cave]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mark of Altruism appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Mark of Altruism was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Hero of Tatooine|"Hero of Tatooine" questline]],<ref name="SWG" /> released with "[[W:c:swg:Publish 9 Notes for 29 June 04|Publish 9]]" on [[June 29]], [[2004]].<ref>{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?page=Recent%20Updates|text=Publish 9 Secrets of the Force}}</ref> The "Hero of Tatooine" questline was extensively revamped upon the introduction of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]],<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> but the quest rewards, such as the "Mark of Altruism," were not altered.<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />
